verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at pipedream.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) describing Pipedream Connect's managed auth, MCP servers and API tooling, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The agent-focused MCP developer docs add further agent-oriented material. Missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt covers the full docs rather than just the Connect app marketplace, any llms-full.txt or per-page markdown docs, and independent or community corroboration of agents using it.
